skill.name: specdd-docs
skill.description: Guides agents to write or update documentation from active SpecDD specs while preserving governing project constraints.
skill.summary: Spec-based documentation guidance for SpecDD projects.
skill.author: specdd

content.value_statement: Spec-driven projects need documentation that matches current contracts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to update docs from active SpecDD specs.
actual_capabilities: Guides documentation work from an active SpecDD bootstrap chain.
Defines the order for reading bootstrap files before applying project rules.
Directs agents to resolve governing specs and write authority before edits.
Keeps documentation aligned with specs, tasks, examples, and tests.
Requires reporting the specs used, docs changed, and underspecified behavior.
limitations: Applies only to projects with a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.
Does not provide executable automation or concrete CLI commands.
Cannot authorize edits unless governing specs grant write authority.
Depends on accurate specs and implementation evidence.

use_cases.title: Update Feature Documentation
use_cases.description: Refresh user-facing docs after a SpecDD contract changes, while preserving documented constraints.

use_cases.title: Prepare Implementation Notes
use_cases.description: Create concise technical docs that explain specified behavior without adding unsupported promises.

use_cases.title: Review Documentation Scope
use_cases.description: Check whether requested documentation edits have authority from the active spec chain.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-docs to update the documentation for [feature]. Read the active bootstrap and governing specs before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Write New Spec-Based Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-docs to draft documentation for [behavior]. Source every claim from the active specs and implementation evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review Docs Against Specs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-docs to review [document]. Identify claims that are unsupported, outdated, or missing important constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Documentation Authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-docs to determine which specs govern [target path]. Report the write authority, docs to change, and any underspecified behavior.

output_examples.input: Update the README section for the invitation flow from active SpecDD specs.
output_examples.output: The invitation flow section is updated, the governing specs are listed, and one underspecified expiration rule is reported.

output_examples.input: Review the install guide against the changed setup specs.
output_examples.output: The review identifies two unsupported claims, one missing constraint, and the spec files used for the comparison.

output_examples.input: Write docs for the new export behavior without expanding the contract.
output_examples.output: The draft explains the specified export behavior, avoids unsupported guarantees, and notes tests that support the documented flow.

best_practices: Confirm the project has a root .specdd/bootstrap.md before using this skill.
Resolve the governing spec chain and write authority before editing documentation.
Report the specs used, documents changed, and any behavior that remains underspecified.
anti_patterns: Using this skill in a non-SpecDD project without an explicit adoption request.
Adding promises, APIs, or workflows that are not supported by specs or implementation.
Inferring write authority from nearby files, names, or conventions alone.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides documentation writing and updates from active SpecDD specs.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and does not define executable commands.

faq.question: Can it be used outside SpecDD projects?
faq.answer: No. It requires a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file before continuing.

faq.question: How does it prevent unsupported docs?
faq.answer: It tells the agent to source claims from specs and implementation evidence.

faq.question: What should the final report include?
faq.answer: The report should include specs used, docs changed, and underspecified behavior.
